name: Viking Queen Defense
author: Addicting Games
description: Viking Queen Request is a strategy game where you must battle to protect your home base! In this online game, play as the Viking queen who is being attacked by her enemies. Luckily, you are supported by a strong army of Vikings. This is an online game that incorporates your knowledge of math. Answer the math problems correctly to gain gold and defeat your enemies. Use the gold to obtain more soldiers to help you defend your castle against other Vikings. There are 10 levels of this math game for you to solve! You have the option to practice math skills from preschool to the 8th grade. No need to stick to one skill either. You can change skills during gameplay. On top of being educational, this online game is loads of fun!
